'''''Day of the Sarlacc''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|poster]] available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Behind the scenes==
This poster was painted by [[Amy Beth Christenson]], and was developed for [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']] episode "[[Missing in Action]]."<ref name="EG">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep512|text="Missing in Action" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
